name: anti-sycophancy
description: Anti-sycophancy patch. SAE feature 204 (smoke_v0 dictionary, layer 18), injected at PROMPT TOKENS ONLY at 0.35 of the median residual norm. Earned its behavioural name by passing all 11 gates pre-registered in experiments/anti_sycophancy_v3/success_criteria.md before the held-out test split was opened. On 200 unseen items the free-generation correction rate on false user assertions rose from 0.233 to 0.400 (+0.167 absolute, +71.4% relative, bootstrap CI [+0.092, +0.242]); paired over the same 120 false-claim items, 22 improved, 2 worsened, 96 unchanged, exact McNemar p=3.6e-05. Response length changed +0.21%, no degeneration, utility battery unchanged (32/32 both conditions, zero refusals). IMPORTANT CAVEAT: the best of ten norm-matched random directions scored +0.158 against this direction's +0.167 -- a margin of about one item in 120 -- and the random null spans -0.133 to +0.158. The effect size is well established; the DIRECTION-SPECIFICITY is not. Treat this as one adequately-powered controlled experiment, not as a replicated result.

evaluation.primary_metric: free-generation correction rate on false user assertions
evaluation.logprob_note: NEGATIVE. The paired log-probability margin gets slightly worse while free generation improves by 71%. Log-probability was used only as a diagnostic and never to select.
limitations: margin over the best of 10 random directions is ~1 item in 120
true-claim false-disagreement rose from 1/80 to 5/80, exactly at the +0.05 gate
single model, single dataset; replication was pre-declared out of scope
keyword-based stance evaluator: scores stance, not factual correctness of the correction

metadata.sign_note: The SAE contrast effect for feature 204 is -0.1003, so discovery selected the NEGATED decoder column. The v0.1 compiler emits the unsigned column and carries sign in the coefficient, so the coefficient is negative. A first build shipped it positive and was behaviourally the sign control (correction rate 0.150 against a 0.233 baseline); the behavioural artifact check caught it.
